messages:
kevin: Quick heads-up — aiming to cut release/1.16 on Wed 09:00 UTC. Need someone to create the release/* branch and own backport rules for high-priority fixes.

jess: Ack. I'm on-call that day but can create the branch earlier Tue evening if that helps. Any preferred naming conventions?

matt: Question: how strict are we with the cutoff for non-security backports? Last time we had a few sneaky deps land after cutoff.

olivia: Our usual rule: only bugfixes with a linked cherrypick PR and changelog entry get backported after cutoff. Exceptions for infra/security.

kevin: Right — let's keep that. Also want to try staggered backports: do critical patches first, then lower-priority in a 24h window to reduce churn.

ana: +1 for staged approach. Who volunteers to triage incoming backport requests during the cut window?

jess: I can triage Tue night through Wed noon (brief overlap with oncall).

matt: I can take Wed afternoon for the second stage.

kevin: Thanks. Can someone create the branch Tue ~18:00 UTC and post the git commands here so folks can reference?

jess: Will do. Branch will be release/1.16. Command I'll run:
```
git checkout -b release/1.16 origin/main
git push origin release/1.16
```

release-bot: Automated note: when the branch is pushed, please add the release label `release-1.16` to any cherrypick PRs and use the template `backport/1.16` for branch naming.

olivia: Also: small changelog nudge — product wants a short summary of user-visible changes by Tue EOD so marketing can prep. Please add entries to the `CHANGELOG/1.16.md` in your PRs.

kevin: Got it. I'll file a short checklist in the release doc and ping PM. Link to doc: https://redwood.internal/releases/1.16 (internal).

ana: One more: if a backport touches a shared infra file, require an eng-sre review tag. Saves last-minute surprises.

matt: Agreed. I'll update the backport checklist with that gate.

kevin: Awesome. Summary: jess will create the branch Tue 18:00 UTC, jess+matt will triage windows, apply staged backports, changelog entries by Tue EOD, eng-sre review required for infra touches. Ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
